/-- The event with id `e`: its timeline row, else the outlier. -/
def eventOf (s : Snapshot) (e : Nat) : Option Pdu :=
  match (timeline s).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e) with
  | some p => some p
  | none => (s.pdus.val.filter (fun p => p.outlier)).find? (fun p => p.event_id.val = e)

spec.name: membershipAt
spec.code:
/-- A user's membership in state snapshot `h`; none recorded, or content
that does not parse, counts as `leave`. -/
def membershipAt (s : Snapshot) (h u : Nat) : Membership :=
  match stateLookup s h .Member u with
  | some p => match p.membership with
    | .Is m => m
    | .Absent => .Leave
  | none => .Leave

spec.name: visibilityAt
spec.code:
/-- The history visibility in state snapshot `h`; none recorded, or content
that does not parse, counts as `shared`. -/
def visibilityAt (s : Snapshot) (h : Nat) : HistoryVisibility :=
  match stateLookup s h .HistoryVisibility 0 with
  | some p => match p.history_visibility with
    | .Is v => v
    | .Absent => .Shared
  | none => .Shared

spec.name: Joined
spec.code: def Joined (s : Snapshot) (u room : Nat) : Prop := ∃ x ∈ s.joined.val, x.user.val = u ∧ x.room.val = room

spec.name: stateLookup
spec.code:
/-- The event under `(kind, state_key)` in state snapshot `h`. -/
def stateLookup (s : Snapshot) (h : Nat) (k : Kind) (key : Nat) : Option Pdu :=
  match stateEntries s h with
  | none => none
  | some es =>
    match es.find? (fun en => en.kind = k ∧ en.state_key.val = key) with
    | none => none
    | some en => eventOf s en.event_id.val

    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 428:0-459:1

def transition
  (s : Snapshot) (req : Request) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  match req.op with
  | Op.Messages room «from» «to» dir limit filter =>
    api_message.get_message_events_route s req.user room «from» «to» dir
      limit filter
  | Op.Context room event limit filter =>
    api_context.get_context_route s req.user room event limit filter
  | Op.Relations room event rel_type event_type «from» «to» limit recurse
    dir =>
    api_relations.paginate_relations_with_filter s req.user room event
      event_type rel_type «from» «to» limit recurse dir
  | Op.Threads room «from» limit participated =>
    api_threads.get_threads_route s req.user room «from» limit participated
  | Op.State room => api_state.get_state_events_route s req.user room
  | Op.StateEvent room kind state_key =>
    api_state.get_state_events_for_key_route s req.user room kind state_key
  | Op.Members room «at» membership not_membership =>
    api_members.get_member_events_route s req.user room «at» membership
      not_membership
  | Op.JoinedMembers room => api_members.joined_members_route s req.user room
  | Op.InitialSync room limit =>
    api_room.room_initial_sync_route s req.user room limit
  | Op.RoomEvent room event =>
    api_room.get_room_event_route s req.user room event
  | Op.ServerCanSee origin room event =>
    let b ← svc_accessor.server_can_see_event s origin room event
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.CanSee b))

def api_members.get_member_events_route
  (s : Snapshot) (user : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) («at» : Token)
  (membership : Option Membership) (not_membership : Option Membership) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  let b ← svc_accessor.user_can_see_state_events s user room
  if b
  then
    match «at» with
    | Token.Absent =>
      let r ← svc_timeline.get_room_shortstatehash s room
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok h =>
        let v ← svc_accessor.state_full s h
        let chunk ←
          api_members.get_member_events_route_loop0 s membership not_membership
            v (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64) 0#usize
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Members chunk))
      | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Database)
    | Token.At c =>
      let r ← svc_timeline.shortstatehash_after s room c
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok h =>
        let v ← svc_accessor.state_full s h
        let chunk ←
          api_members.get_member_events_route_loop1 s membership not_membership
            v (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64) 0#usize
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.Members chunk))
      | core.result.Result.Err e => ok (core.result.Result.Err e)
    | Token.Invalid => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.InvalidParam)
  else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)

def api_members.joined_members_route
  (s : Snapshot) (user : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  let is_joined ← svc_cache.is_joined s user room
  let o ← svc_accessor.room_history_visibility s room
  let is_world_readable ←
    match o with
    | none => ok false
    | some hv =>
      match hv with
      | HistoryVisibility.WorldReadable => ok true
      | HistoryVisibility.Shared => ok false
      | HistoryVisibility.Invited => ok false
      | HistoryVisibility.Joined => ok false
      | HistoryVisibility.Custom _ => ok false
  if is_joined
  then
    let r ← svc_accessor.room_state_full s room
    let v ←
      match r with
      | core.result.Result.Ok v1 => ok v1
      | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.Usize)
    let joined ←
      api_members.joined_members_route_loop0 s v (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64)
        0#usize
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.JoinedMembers joined))
  else
    if is_world_readable
    then
      let r ← svc_accessor.room_state_full s room
      let v ←
        match r with
        | core.result.Result.Ok v1 => ok v1
        | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.Usize)
      let joined ←
        api_members.joined_members_route_loop1 s v (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U64)
          0#usize
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.JoinedMembers joined))
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Forbidden)

def api_room.get_room_event_route
  (s : Snapshot) (user : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) (event_id : Std.U64) :
  Result (core.result.Result Reply Error)
  := do
  let event ← svc_timeline.get_pdu s event_id
  let visible ← svc_accessor.user_can_see_event s user room event_id
  match event with
  | core.result.Result.Ok p =>
    if visible
    then
      let p1 ←
        alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Pdu) 
          s.pdus p
      let b ← api_message.is_ignored_pdu s p1 user
      if b
      then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.SenderIgnored)
      else ok (core.result.Result.Ok (Reply.RoomEvent p1.event_id))
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NotFound)
  | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.NotFound)

/-- [tuwunel_kernel::svc_accessor::server_can_see_event]:
    Source: 'src/svc_accessor.rs', lines 262:0-275:1
    Visibility: public -/
def svc_accessor.server_can_see_event
  (s : Snapshot) (origin : Std.U64) (room : Std.U64) (event_id : Std.U64) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let r ← svc_timeline.pdu_shortstatehash s event_id
  match r with
  | core.result.Result.Ok hash =>
    let hv ← svc_accessor.history_visibility_at s hash
    let members ← svc_cache.room_members s room
    match hv with
    | HistoryVisibility.WorldReadable => ok true
    | HistoryVisibility.Shared => ok true
    | HistoryVisibility.Invited =>
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref members
      svc_accessor.any_member_was s hash origin s1 false
    | HistoryVisibility.Joined =>
      let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref members
      svc_accessor.any_member_was s hash origin s1 true
    | HistoryVisibility.Custom _ => ok true
  | core.result.Result.Err _ => ok true
